'''Albert Rosas Ubach''' (born 19 August 2002), sometimes known as '''Berto''', is an Andorran professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[forward (association football)|forward]] for Spanish club [[UD Logroñés]], on loan from [[FC Andorra]], and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].

==Career==
A youth product of [[FC Andorra]] and [[Lleida Esportiu]], Rosas made his senior debut with [[Atlético Monzón]], being loaned to the club on 2 August 2021.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/esports/2021/08/02/albert_rosas_fitxa_per_atletic_montso_184538_1128.html|title=Albert Rosas fitxa per l'Atlètic Montsó|date=August 2, 2021|website=DiariAndorra.ad}}</ref> On 1 August 2022, after scoring 16 goals for Monzón during the [[2021–22 Tercera División RFEF]], he renewed with Andorra until 2025 and was loaned to [[Segunda Federación]] side [[Utebo FC]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcandorra.com/berto-renova-i-sen-va-cedit-a-lutebo/|title=Berto renova i se'n va cedit a l'Utebo|trans-title=Berto renews and moves out on loan to Utebo|publisher=FC Andorra|language=ca|date=1 August 2022|accessdate=1 August 2022|archive-date=2 August 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220802092928/https://www.fcandorra.com/berto-renova-i-sen-va-cedit-a-lutebo/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

On 31 January 2023, after scoring 11 goals overall for Utebo, Rosas was loaned to [[Real Betis]]' [[Betis Deportivo Balompié|reserves]], also in the fourth tier.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcandorra.com/noticies/berto-rosas-sen-va-cedit-al-filial-del-betis|title=Berto Rosas se'n va cedit al filial del Betis|trans-title=Berto Rosas moves out on loan to the reserve team of Betis|publisher=FC Andorra|language=ca|date=31 January 2023|accessdate=31 January 2023}}</ref> His loan with the latter was extended for a further year on 26 June,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.betisweb.com/web/berto-rosas-renueva-por-una-temporada-mas/|title=Berto Rosas renueva por una temporada más|trans-title=Berto Rosas renews for one further season|publisher=Betis Web|language=es|date=26 June 2023|accessdate=11 August 2025}}</ref> and he finished the [[2023–24 Segunda Federación|2023–24 season]] with 17 appearances overall as the club achieved promotion to [[Primera Federación]].

Upon returning, Rosas was assigned to Andorra's first team now also in the third division, but was rarely used and left on loan to [[CD Atlético Baleares]] back in the fourth tier on 30 January 2025; he also agreed to a contract extension with his parent club until 2027.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcandorra.com/en/news/berto-rosas-renewal-loan|title=Berto Rosas renews for two seasons and goes on loan|publisher=FC Andorra|date=30 January 2025|accessdate=11 August 2025}}</ref> On 11 August, he joined fellow league team [[UD Logroñés]] also in a temporary deal.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcandorra.com/en/news/berto-rosas-on-loan|title=Berto Rosas, loaned to UD Logroñés|publisher=FC Andorra|date=11 August 2025|accessdate=11 August 2025}}</ref>

After helping Logroñés to [[2025–26 Segunda Federación|achieve promotion to division three]], Rosas' loan was extended for a further year on 23 July 2026, with his contract with Andorra being extended until 2028.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fcandorra.com/en/news/berto-rosas-renews-loaned-logrones|title=Berto Rosas renews and is loaned to Logroñés|publisher=FC Andorra|date=23 July 2026|accessdate=24 July 2026}}</ref>

==International career==
Rosas debuted with the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]] in a 4–1 [[2022 FIFA World Cup qualification]] loss to [[Poland national football team|Poland]] on 12 November 2021.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/report/_/gameId/590240|title=Andorra vs. Poland – Football Match Report – November 12, 2021 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com}}</ref>
